THINKIFIC_SUBDOMAIN.description: Your Thinkific site subdomain (e.g. my-school from my-school.thinkific.com)

GRAPHQL_PORT.description: Port for the optional GraphQL endpoint.

GRAPHQL_ENABLED.description: Whether to enable the optional GraphQL endpoint.

UE_PROJECT_PATH.description: Path to your Unreal Engine project folder.

ASSET_LIST_TTL_MS.description: Time-to-live for asset caching in milliseconds.

MCP_AUTOMATION_PORT.description: The port number for the Automation Bridge connection.

MCP_AUTOMATION_ALLOW_NON_LOOPBACK.description: Set to true to allow binding to non-loopback addresses (e.g., 0.0.0.0). Only enable if you understand the security implications.

MCP_AUTOMATION_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout for automation requests in milliseconds.
